recommended_generic_contract.input: Include a source-anchored alleged_target_clause and alleged_qualification as untrusted hypotheses while continuing to omit classifier reasons/confidence and semantic boolean conclusions.
recommended_generic_contract.output: Require independently selected exact target clause, exact original-source proof handles, independent qualification and source-authority class, with explicit exact_claim_confirmed outcome.
recommended_generic_contract.validation: Deterministically validate target substring/source handles/roles/event identity and reject structural inconsistency. Retain all original model assessments and distinguish agreement/uncertainty; do not describe validation as semantic truth.
recommended_generic_contract.commit: Accepted material claim must use the independently checked scope/qualification, or remain unresolved when the checker instead supports a different clause. Do not silently attach a narrower checker interpretation to a broader primary claim.

risks: Passing alleged qualification can anchor critic; preserve independent rederivation and withhold persuasive primary prose.
Strict minimal substring requirements can strip necessary surrounding qualifications; retain full target text and separate quote span/qualification.
A structured checker can still agree on the same semantic false positive; no F1 improvement is established.
Additional output/request tokens and schema retry rates must be budgeted and measured.
Compound targets legitimately admit different relations on different clauses; do not blanket-reject partial supports or supports-plus-supersedes.
